details:
Q1. Which part of this repository should the change target?
Choices:
A. One specific workflow, script, or file in `coding-workflows` — name the exact workflow/file if you know it (RECOMMENDED)
B. One pipeline phase — `clarify`, `plan`, `implement`, `review_autofix`, `orchestrate`, or `validate` — and the specific workflow/script inside it if known
C. Repository docs/onboarding only — for example `README.md`, wrapper setup, or usage docs
D. A cross-phase change affecting multiple named components — list each component
Q2. What concrete problem should be fixed in that target area?
Choices:
A. Broken or incorrect behavior — include the observed symptom, error text, and any failing run/PR/issue reference (RECOMMENDED)
B. Missing capability — describe what the workflow/tool should do but currently does not
C. Performance or reliability problem — describe what is slow, flaky, duplicated, or noisy
D. Usability/docs problem — describe what is confusing or hard to use
Q3. What specific result should count as “better” when this issue is done?
Choices:
A. A clear before/after behavior or short acceptance checklist (RECOMMENDED)
B. Make a named failing workflow/PR/issue/run succeed again
C. Match the behavior of another named workflow/script/file in this repo
D. Improve a specific metric — name the metric and target (for example runtime, retries, API calls, or alert noise)
